dedupe_keys.name: wallonia hydrometry portal river levels flows and rainfall stations spw

description: The Service public de Wallonie publishes observations of its hydrometric network on the portal L'hydrométrie en Wallonie: water levels, discharges and rainfall at measuring stations, the state of the main rivers with flood warnings, reports and publications, and news of new stations on the Meuse, Sambre and Vesdre. The station list with coordinates can be downloaded from the observation maps. Data for one or several stations are requested with a form and sent by email; each request is limited to 250,000 values, a little over two years of 5-minute data for one station. The dam and waterway directorate's hydrology pages link to this portal and to fact sheets on flow measurement and the Wacondah network. Coverage is the Walloon region of Belgium, including the navigable waterways. Access is free; an account pre-fills the request form. Caveats: the observation map rendered empty in the cloud session and the licence was not found. Simulation uses: high-resolution river level and flow series for flood warning, reservoir and waterway operation studies. Related records: the Polish ISOK hydroportal (data-poland-isok-hydroportal-flood-hazard-risk-maps) and the Global Runoff Data Centre (data-grdc-global-runoff-database).
